title: interruption payload
description: The DataPart 'data' object the Live layer sends on barge-in, alongside tasks/cancel for the in-flight task (spec §8). The task then transitions to CANCELED and the next utterance begins a new task under the same context (roll-forward model). Every field is optional: the Live layer SHOULD send each field it can supply, and the Reasoner applies the per-field fallback when one is absent.

played_text.description: Text actually heard by the caller. If absent, the Reasoner SHOULD treat the whole planned response as unplayed.

planned_text.description: Full planned response. If absent, the Reasoner SHOULD use the response it generated for the interrupted task.

unspoken_text.description: Remaining, unspoken portion of the response. If absent, the Reasoner SHOULD derive it from planned_text and played_text.

interrupted_task_id.description: taskId of the interrupted task. If absent, the Reasoner SHOULD assume the most recent task in the context.

interrupted_request_guid.description: requestGuid of the interrupted response chunk. If absent, the Reasoner SHOULD correlate at the task level only.
